task.name: pick_vial_place_right_slot
task.description: Use the right arm to pick up the vial and place it in the right empty slot on the rack.

substages.substage: 1. Move the right arm to approach and align with the vial.
2. Grasp the vial with the right arm.
3. Move the right arm to align with the right empty slot on the rack.
4. Release the gripper to place the vial into the right empty slot on the rack.
